scope: The standing Chaleemongkolasana and Maleeratanabanlang exteriors at Sanam Chandra Palace and their physically attached upper-floor covered crossing. Includes the north château façade and spired corner towers, red-tile roofs, timber Thai-Western residence and roofed bridge. The separately placed dog monument, shrine and northern halls have independent scopes.

primaryWrittenSources.author: Sunon Palakavong Na Ayudhya
primaryWrittenSources.facts: The two-storey concrete and red-tiled château has a pointed arch and timber detailing. The attached two-storey red teak residence uses rounded arches, a red tile hipped roof and a timber corridor bridge that meets both upper floors over the moat.

primaryWrittenSources.author: Sanamchandra Palace Library, Silpakorn University
primaryWrittenSources.facts: Both named residences survive within the palace grounds and were restored.
